value.rationale: At the actual threshold where stable polarized opinion states collide, the global relaxation time becomes algebraic rather than exponential. The explicit parameter-dependent critical amplitude distinguishes response intensities even when local equilibrium diagrams coincide and gives a model-based quantification of critical slowing for all initially asymmetric populations. Paired global Lyapunov functions rule out hidden recurrent behavior, making the critical law a complete dynamical statement, not a routine isolated Taylor expansion.
